Plugins

Native capabilities exposed as web interfaces.

Current plugins

  • @palmshed/secure-storage. Secure storage for sensitive application data. Works across Android (EncryptedSharedPreferences), iOS (Keychain), and web (development fallback).

Structure

Each plugin lives in its own directory under packages/. A plugin includes:

  • TypeScript source defining the web interface
  • Android implementation in Kotlin
  • iOS implementation in Swift
  • Tests for all three platforms
  • Documentation with examples

Possible future plugins

These are candidates, not commitments. Each will be added only when real projects need them.

  • Share. Native share sheet integration
  • File Access. Document picker and file system access
  • Biometrics. Fingerprint and face recognition
  • Local Notifications. Scheduled and immediate notifications
  • Reader. EPUB and PDF viewing helpers

Adding a plugin

See the contribution guide for the process of adding a new plugin.
